summary: Implemented WORKSHOP-BUILDER-02 locally: literal admin demo entry (server-issued admin/hr scopes, no token form), persistent PostgreSQL rooms with score/choice/text questions, reorder and strict post-answer locks, publish/open/close/end lifecycle, participant join/answer (idempotent, no duplicates), realtime facilitator WS fed by an internal room-scoped grant, active-question-first charts with n/base, latest-five text plus stable cursor pagination, and a read-only HR mode enforced server-side. New builder UI follows the approved R02 structure (compact rows, question rail, wide editor + participant preview, neutral chrome, sparse teal, logo asset, 44px controls, focus/reduced motion, deliberate mobile layout). Native tests 145 pass/1 skip/0 fail; builder API tests 9/9; typecheck/default+LAN builds 0; fresh real API/DB flow and reload persistence verified; additive migration 0004 applied. Browser screenshots/real visual-mobile checks, dedicated builder UI tests, Mode B regression, cloud deployment and independent QA are NOT RUN.
user_decision: Implement the approved Unslop R02 direction; do not reuse rejected R01; weak demo admin access is intentional.

cases.limitations: Browser screenshots/real visual, mobile, keyboard and reduced-motion checks NOT RUN.

Mode B Docker regression, cloud deployment, physical phone/Safari, independent QA.
